dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Your abode is both comfortable and homely, and the decor within and without is most rich in style. It exudes the fine tastes of its host.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: #For inviting me here, you have my sincerest gratitude, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Your concern is most touching. Fret not, for I am enjoying myself.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Every conceivable need is met here — a testament to the host's meticulous thoughtfulness.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Hardly. I came here empty-handed, bearing not even a gift.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: But you treated me to dishes you prepared, and so I offered you sincere compliments in return. It's only polite.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: But aside from this desire, born out of mere curiosity, all my other material needs are met.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're very welcome!

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: You are much too kind. If you truly wished for me to nitpick, then I suppose I might offer some critical suggestions regarding the allocation of accommodations here.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: If convenient, perhaps I could request for a room that is quieter, and in a more secluded spot?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Accustomed as I am to living alone in a cemetery for many years, a gloomy environment is in fact more comfortable for me.

choices.text: Let me know if anything is lacking.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Your home is rich in storage, fitting for an adventurer as well-traveled as yourself. I have no doubt that these nooks hold treasures aplenty.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: If you have a moment, I would love for us to view the spoils of your journey together.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I certainly would. What is on your mind today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can't remember what I wanted to talk about...

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: That is well. We can discuss any matter you please. Death, freedom, meaning, and solitude... or what we shall have to eat later.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: And yet — perhaps I understand this state of yours.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: When people deliberately seek conversation with others, it's... it is easy for their efforts to be in vain.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: If we wish to speak, we should not hesitate. Whatever thoughts linger in your heart, say them, and do so decisively.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: No matter how trivial these thoughts may seem, what matters is that they are said and heard.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: For instance, if you see an insect on your way out today, or if you plan to go fishing later.

choices.text: I thought of something. Why do you keep your hair long, Flins?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: You mean, why do I not cut it short and neat, like my colleagues? Why this look, of all choices?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: ...I see, I did not expect you to take an interest in my appearance. Hmm, yes, knowing this has helped me understand you better.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Have you heard the saying? "One's appearance is a reflection of their innermost thoughts and experiences."

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: There was a time when my long, smooth hair was a symbol of my status. It was a habit for me, back then...

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: I suppose this will suffice as an answer to your question.

choices.text: I thought of something. Do you know anything about Snezhnograd, Flins?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: I recall that you intend to visit Snezhnograd in the future. It is indeed necessary to gather relevant information before your departure.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: ...Regrettably, my memories of it are hazy, but what remains tells me that it was a beautiful place.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: The brilliant night sky, the never-ending blizzard... It seems that nowadays, it's become rather industrialized.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Some fae still live there. Perhaps they have gotten used to the biting cold, and are no longer able to survive in a warm place.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Hmm... I wonder what Snezhnograd looks like now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I... I have been sleepless of late.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is the bedding here not to your tastes?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Oh, no, please don't misunderstand. The beds here are absolutely delightful, far more than I require.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Besides, for someone of my particular habitation arrangements, I have never lost sleep on account of the outside environment.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then...?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Lately, I've been longing for that time, long ago, when I slept alone in absolute darkness.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: It was a slumber without dreams, without consciousness, without joy, and without pain.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: It was a strange sensation. An absolute state of peace and emptiness.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Perhaps it is difficult for most people to understand, but I was immersed in that slumber for a long time indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Compared to it, the dreamful sleep that normal humans experience every night feels almost... too noisy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't suppose you want to...

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: ...To extinguish myself again? Hehehe, of course not.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Thinking about my past experiences is merely a way for me to review my current judgments and position.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: To yearn for peace, and to forsake it for a new purpose — these paths do not conflict.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I hope my prattling on and on does not bore you.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Then all is well. The fact I can share these trivial thoughts with you is proof of our friendship.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: That is fine. There is always a difference between two individuals, and to fully bridge that gap of understanding is a nigh-insurmountable task.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: But it is precisely because we think differently that our conversations are meaningful.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Flins.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Good morning to you too. I wish you a smooth journey ahead, and the fulfillment of all that you may desire.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Flins.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Good night. Do enjoy a restful night of sweet dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I am accustomed to acting in the dead of night. Perhaps I shall take a stroll through your courtyard, under the silver light of the moon...

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: More impressive than the insight required to capture the grey-brown fortress's appearance is the admirable patience you've displayed in reconstructing it...

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Hold on. Do allow me to look up — I don't suppose this streetlight is broken by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Ah, wonderful. Seeing it shining as brightly as before puts my mind at ease. Were even such fine details painstakingly recreated, my admiration for you might come closer to fear and trembling instead.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Perhaps we might consider this mutual influence.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Ratniki become cold, solid, and tough by living alongside these taciturn tables and chairs... while they in turn bear the inevitable rust and tool marks left by time.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Let us pay our respects to those who came before us with a brief moment of silence.
